findings.title: A graph whose mode is off can hold two edges of one triple
findings.intended: Spec 234 FR-002: with the mode off a triple never gets a second edge; GID-I4.10.
findings.remedy: Guard the single-edge writers on the triple whatever its ekey, or refuse mode off while an edge has a non-zero ekey (or renumber the lone edge to 0).
findings.notes: Impact reproduced too: after a per-edge delete of the ekey-1 row the surviving ekey-0 row has no ^KG out leaf and verify_graph reports 1 missing out and 1 missing in entry.

observed.verdict: two rows of one triple in a mode-off graph
observed.oracle: mode off => at most one row per triple (spec 234 FR-002)

verify_graph_drift.detail: rows in Graph_KG.rdf_edges with no ^KG("out") entry, so traversal cannot see them
rows with no ^KG("in") entry, so inbound traversal cannot see them

findings.title: The name check is not run at every entry that takes a graph name
findings.intended: ADR-0003 (docs/adr/0003-two-graph-key-derivations.md:119-121): the validator rejects the name '0'.
findings.remedy: Call validate_graph_name at every entry (create_node, store_node, store_edge, bulk paths, BulkLoader, USE GRAPH) and write the canonical name.
findings.notes: create_node and store_node wrote rows under graph '0'; node_count and delete_node then refuse the name (the rows cannot be read or removed through the API that wrote them); store_edge into '0' fails late with the server's ERROR #5001 inside a SQLCODE -400.

observed.verdict: 2 node rows written under the reserved graph name 0
observed.oracle: every writer that takes a graph name refuses the reserved name "0" (ADR-0003:119-121)

findings.title: The graph check reports a multigraph's parallel edges as missing adjacency
findings.intended: Spec 234 SC-005: zero drift on a multigraph after random creates and deletes.
findings.remedy: Compare rows per (s,p,o) with the keyed '#' count.
findings.notes: Same defect as F-0403. Three parallel edges, keyed count 3: verify reports ok 0 with 2 missing out and in entries.

observed.oracle: verify_graph(g)['ok'] is true for a multigraph whose index matches its rows

findings.title: Direct edge writes, the ledger and Bolt do not track parallel edges, and the user docs do not say so
findings.intended: Spec 234 FR-007/FR-012/FR-013 (edge_id identity, ambiguous_tuple refusal); its status line says US4 not done.
findings.remedy: Implement FR-007/012/013 or document each limit.
findings.notes: Not reproduced live (Bolt server not started in the audit; ledger-on-multigraph left to the ledger lane).
findings.observed: Bolt gives a relationship id hash(f'{s}-{type}-{o}') (iris_vector_graph/bolt_server.py:770); LedgerApply.FindEdge takes the first row of the triple (iris_src/src/Graph/KG/LedgerApply.cls:144-157). Re-read at the pin.

findings.title: Some Python readers join one graph's ids with another graph's data
findings.intended: USER_GUIDE.md:466-467 (graph= omitted means the default graph); HD-0201 (assumption): no join of ids from one scope to records of another.
findings.remedy: Hydrate each id from its own graph; give _filter_edges_by_properties and set_edge_weight a graph.
findings.notes: get_nodes_by_label(L) answered the default graph's node (labels ['Other']) for an id labelled L only in a named graph.

observed.verdict: answered the default graph's node, which lacks the label
observed.oracle: every node answered for label L holds L (and its properties) in its own graph

findings.title: Turning the mode off races a write that adds a parallel edge
findings.intended: Spec 234 FR-002 (the refusal exists to keep a mode-off graph single-edge).
findings.remedy: Hold a lock the multigraph writers also take across the count and the kill.
findings.notes: Check gid_mode-as-built-F0207 (GID-I4.10) gives the race trace; the reviewed design with the shared lock passes exhaustively; control gid_mode-control-writers-unlocked is caught. Not provoked live: the window lies inside one class method.
findings.observed: GraphMode.Set counts parallel triples with one SQL query then kills the setting, no lock, no transaction (iris_src/src/Graph/KG/GraphMode.cls:26-45).

findings.title: An engine keeps a graph's mode forever, so another engine's change is not seen
findings.remedy: Read the mode per statement, expire the cache, or refuse a keyed insert server-side in a mode-off graph.

observed.verdict: stale cache wrote a parallel edge into a mode-off graph
observed.oracle: mode off => at most one row per triple, whichever engine writes (spec 234 FR-002)

findings.title: An all-graphs walk can miss graphs
findings.intended: An all-graphs read is the union over every graph (CONTEXT.md:38-43).
findings.remedy: List without a cap and raise on failure.
findings.notes: Not run: needs 10,001 graphs with edges.
findings.observed: _edge_graphs stops after 10,000 graphs and answers [] on any error (iris_vector_graph/_engine/query.py:2408-2420).
